label: Basic
description: Basic tooltip. Best for the bare minimum: an outline button and a single line hint, Add to library, shown above it while held.

label: Placements
description: Tooltips above and below. Best for the 2 sides a phone tooltip opens on, one button each.

label: Icon Trigger
description: Tooltip on an icon button. Best for a ghost info button with no visible text, named for screen readers, holding a line of help copy.

label: Keyboard Shortcut
description: Tooltip with a keyboard shortcut. Best for a small save icon button whose hint pairs the action with its key caps, for a hardware keyboard.

label: Bell With Count
description: Tooltip on a bell with a count. Best for an icon button with a count badge whose bubble lists 3 recent notifications under a heading.

label: Status Badges
description: Tooltip with status badges. Best for a System status button whose bubble lists 3 services with Operational or Degraded badges and an updated time.

label: Verified Domain
description: Tooltip on an inline icon. Best for a check mark after a verified domain, revealing a Verified heading and a one line explanation.

label: Toolbar Actions
description: Toolbar with tooltips. Best for bold, italic, underline and image buttons in one toolbar, each named for screen readers and explained while held.

label: Warning
description: Tooltip with a warning. Best for a warning icon button whose bubble warns, behind a matching glyph, that the action cannot be undone.

label: Upgrade Prompt
description: Upgrade prompt. Best for a lock icon button whose long press opens a Pro tagged pitch with an Upgrade to Pro button; a card, since a tooltip cannot hold a button.

label: Avatar Role Badge
description: Tooltip with an avatar and role. Best for an avatar whose bubble repeats it beside the person's name, an Admin badge and an email.

label: Disabled Button
description: Tooltip on a disabled button. Best for a disabled Delete project button wrapped by the tooltip, so the reason it is locked still shows while held.

label: Online Status
description: Tooltip with online status. Best for an avatar with a green presence dot whose bubble repeats it beside the name and Online now.

label: File Info
description: Tooltip with file details. Best for a muted file name in text whose bubble shows its size, upload age and PDF and Verified tags beside a document glyph.

label: Label Badges
description: Tooltip with label badges. Best for a compact 3 labels count with a tag glyph whose bubble shows the 3 coloured labels under a heading.

label: Unread Bell
description: Notification preview with a link. Best for a bell with an unread dot whose long press opens the unread count above a View all link; a card, since a tooltip cannot hold a link.
